svg.title: Folder layout for event and parking clips
svg.desc: Clips are stored under internal storage blackvue/eventos and blackvue/parking, one folder per day. Camera filenames are rewritten into a readable Spanish name.

svg.text: Internal storage. One folder per day. Parking is separate from events.
